doc: Ascent of one northern cyclone (lon 20, lat 50, radius 0.2) of age 1.2: an occluded low (age 1.2): a dry slot at the center of weight (age - 1) 2 = 0.4, on a 41 x 41 gnomonic patch of half-angle 0.4 rad around it (float32 directions, as the generator passes them). Float32 chain (squared chord distance, exp, 2 gaussians). Tolerance rtol 5e-5, atol 5e-6: over the single-vortex float32 cases the float64-promoted computation differs by at most 3.1e-7 and a one-ulp nudge of the directions by 9e-7 (the oldest low, 0.44 of the default band); tolerance 10 times the worst, rounded up. Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN).

params.dtype_chain: p float32: a = float32 zeros; per vortex the center is cast to float32, d2, exp and the gaussians are float32 (a cyclone takes _comma_ascent, float32; a tropical subtracts its float32 eye); the term is np.float32(ascent) * g.astype(float32) and a += term accumulates in float32, in vortex order.
